files.name: README.md
files.body:
# Quest Board

**An escrowed bounty board on Gno.land.** Post a task, lock GNOT as the reward, and pay whoever delivers. The reward sits in the realm's escrow until the poster awards it or it is refunded, and every address builds a public, on-chain record of what it paid out and what it earned.

- **Live on the Gno.land testnet (onyx-1):** _deployment link added after deploy_
- **Realm path:** `gno.land/r/g1rwxskhs8tm98yxcj5tuehwplwnqzacuqsqgrtq/questboard`
- Built by Crypto Bandit for the Gnome Tavern hackathon.

## Why

Most small bounties on any chain are a promise in a chat message. Hunters don't know whether the poster will actually pay, and posters have no neutral way to hold funds. Quest Board fixes the two parts that matter:

1. **The money is locked up front.** A quest only exists if its reward is sitting in the realm's escrow.
2. **Posters have a track record.** Each address's profile shows how many quests it paid out and how much, and also how many times it **cancelled after work was submitted** or **let a quest expire with hunters waiting**. Hunters can check a poster before they start.

It's useful for anyone who wants work done on Gno: core and ecosystem maintainers ("write tests for package X"), DAOs, hackathon organizers, or someone who just wants a README translated.

## How it works

| Step | Who | Function | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Post | anyone | `PostQuest(title, body, days, arbiter)` + `-send` | Reward ≥ 0.1 GNOT, 1–90 days to submit, optional arbiter |
| Fund | anyone | `Fund(id)` + `-send` | Adds to the reward. Funders are refunded if the quest doesn't pay out |
| Submit | anyone but the poster/arbiter | `Submit(id, link, note)` | `http(s)` link to the work (MR, commit, demo). Resubmitting updates your entry |
| Reject | poster or arbiter | `Reject(id, hunter, reason)` | Public reason. The hunter can resubmit before the deadline |
| Award | poster or arbiter | `Award(id, hunter)` | Pays the **whole** escrow to one hunter. Allowed after the deadline too |
| Cancel | poster or arbiter | `Cancel(id)` | Refunds every funder. If work was already submitted, the poster's profile records it |
| Expire | **anyone** | `Expire(id)` | 7 days after the deadline with no award: refunds every funder, and the poster's profile records hunters were left waiting |

Pages served by `Render` (open them in gnoweb):

- `/r/<addr>/questboard`: board totals, open quests, recently closed
- `/r/<addr>/questboard:quest/<id>`: one quest, its submissions, funders, and one-click action links
- `/r/<addr>/questboard:u/<address>`: an address's track record as poster and hunter

Every action emits an event (`QuestPosted`, `QuestFunded`, `QuestSubmitted`, `QuestRejected`, `QuestAwarded`, `QuestCancelled`, `QuestExpired`) so indexers and bots can follow the board. Other realms can read `QuestCount()`, `RewardOf(id)` and `Stats()`.

## Use it

### From the browser (gnoweb + Adena)

Open the realm page, click **+ Post a quest** or a quest's **Submit your work** link. gnoweb's `$help` page pre-fills the call. Sign it with the [Adena](https://adena.app) wallet, or copy the `gnokey` command it prints.

### From the command line (gnokey)

```sh
REMOTE=https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443
CHAINID=onyx-1
PKG=gno.land/r/g1rwxskhs8tm98yxcj5tuehwplwnqzacuqsqgrtq/questboard

# Post a quest with a 2 GNOT reward and 7 days to submit (no arbiter)
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath $PKG -func PostQuest \
  -args "Add a Render() test to r/demo/counter" \
  -args "Write a _test.gno covering Render() with 0 and 3 increments. Link the MR." \
  -args 7 -args "" \
  -send 2000000ugnot -gas-fee 1000000ugnot -gas-wanted 20000000 \
  -broadcast -chainid $CHAINID -remote $REMOTE mykey

# Submit work as a hunter
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath $PKG -func Submit \
  -args 1 -args "https://gitlab.com/you/repo/-/merge_requests/1" -args "Covers both cases" \
  -gas-fee 1000000ugnot -gas-wanted 20000000 -broadcast -chainid $CHAINID -remote $REMOTE hunterkey

# Award it (poster)
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath $PKG -func Award -args 1 -args <hunter-address> \
  -gas-fee 1000000ugnot -gas-wanted 20000000 -broadcast -chainid $CHAINID -remote $REMOTE mykey

# Read the board without a key
gnokey query vm/qrender -data "$PKG:" -remote $REMOTE
gnokey query vm/qrender -data "$PKG:quest/1" -remote $REMOTE
```

`scripts/tx.sh` wraps these calls (`REMOTE`, `CHAINID`, `KEYHOME` env vars).

## Trust model and limits

Quest Board is an escrow, not a court. Be clear about what it does and doesn't guarantee:

- **Funds can't vanish.** Coins leave the realm only through `Award` (to a hunter who submitted) or a refund to the exact addresses and amounts that funded the quest.
- **The poster decides.** A poster can still refuse to pay and cancel. What they can't do is hide it: cancelling after work was submitted, or ghosting until `Expire`, is written to their public profile. Name an **arbiter** at creation if you want a neutral third party who can also award or cancel.
- **Only direct user calls can send coins.** `PostQuest` and `Fund` reject calls from other realms and `maketx run` scripts, following the `unsafe.OriginSend` guidance used by the core examples, so a phantom deposit can't drain escrow.
- **Only `ugnot` is accepted.** Any other coin in the transaction makes it fail, so nothing gets stuck.
- **Bounded loops and sizes.** At most 50 submissions and 32 funders per quest; title ≤ 80 bytes, body ≤ 4,000, link ≤ 300, note ≤ 500. The home page lists the newest 30 open quests.
- **User text is sanitized** with `gno.land/p/nt/markdown/sanitize/v0` before rendering, so titles, bodies and notes can't inject headings, tables, raw HTML or `javascript:` links.

## Develop

Requires the Gno toolchain (`gno`, `gnokey`, `gnodev`) from [gnolang/gno](https://github.com/gnolang/gno). It was built and tested against `v1.8.0-rc.1`, the version onyx runs.

```sh
gno test -v .          # unit tests (escrow, refunds, deadlines, permissions, rendering)
gno lint .
gnodev local .         # local node + gnoweb at http://127.0.0.1:8888
```

Tests cover posting, funding, submitting, rejecting and resubmitting, awarding (by poster, arbiter, and after the deadline), cancelling (with and without submissions), expiry timing and grace period, input validation (coin denom, minimums, lengths, URL schemes, self-submission), and that rendered markdown is sanitized.

## Files

- `questboard.gno`: escrow state machine and public functions
- `types.gno`: `Quest`, `Submission`, `Contribution`, `Profile`
- `render.gno`: gnoweb pages
- `questboard_test.gno`: tests
- `scripts/tx.sh`: gnokey helper

## License

MIT. Uses Gno.land standard packages (`avl`, `seqid`, `ufmt`, `txlink`, `markdown/sanitize`) from [gnolang/gno](https://github.com/gnolang/gno).

Quest Board is an independent project and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Gno.land.

package questboard

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
)

var (
	realmAddr = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1rwxskhs8tm98yxcj5tuehwplwnqzacuqsqgrtq/questboard")
	alice     = testutils.TestAddress("alice")   // poster
	bob       = testutils.TestAddress("bob")     // hunter
	carol     = testutils.TestAddress("carol")   // hunter
	dave      = testutils.TestAddress("dave")    // funder
	judge     = testutils.TestAddress("arbiter") // arbiter
)

func ugnot(n int64) chain.Coins { return chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: n}} }

func balance(_ realm, a address) int64 {
	return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoins(a).AmountOf("ugnot")
}

// deposit simulates the bank moving -send coins into the realm.
func deposit(n int64) { testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, ugnot(n)) }

func reset() {
	nextID = 0
	quests = avlTree()
	open = avlTree()
	closed = nil
	profiles = avlTree()
	openCount, escrowed, paidOut, refunded, completed = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
}

func post(cur realm, who address, amount int64, arbiter string) int {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(amount))
	deposit(amount)
	return PostQuest(cross(cur), "Write a GRC20 airdrop script", "Needs tests.\n\nMIT license.", 7, arbiter)
}

func TestPostSubmitAward(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := post(cur, alice, 1_000_000, "")
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(500_000))
	deposit(500_000)
	Fund(cross(cur), id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://gitlab.com/bob/airdrop/-/merge_requests/1", "done, with tests")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/carol", "")

	r, st := RewardOf(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_500_000), r)
	uassert.Equal(t, "open", st)

	// Only poster/arbiter can award.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the poster or arbiter can award a quest", func() { Award(cross(cur), id, bob.String()) })

	before := balance(cur, bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Award(cross(cur), id, bob.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_500_000), balance(cur, bob)-before)

	q := mustGet(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusAwarded.String(), q.Status.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, bob.String(), q.Winner.String())
	o, esc, paid, done := Stats()
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, o)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), esc)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_500_000), paid)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, done)

	pa := peekProfile(alice)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, pa.Posted)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, pa.Completed)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_500_000), pa.Paid)
	pb := peekProfile(bob)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, pb.Won)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_500_000), pb.Earned)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500_000), peekProfile(dave).Funded)

	// Closed quests reject everything.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "quest is awarded", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "quest is awarded", func() { Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://x.y", "") })
}

func TestCancelRefundsEveryone(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := post(cur, alice, 2_000_000, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(300_000))
	deposit(300_000)
	Fund(cross(cur), id)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(200_000))
	deposit(200_000)
	Fund(cross(cur), id) // same funder aggregates
	urequire.Equal(t, 2, len(mustGet(id).Contribs))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/bob", "")

	a0, d0 := balance(cur, alice), balance(cur, dave)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the poster or arbiter can cancel a quest", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_000_000), balance(cur, alice)-a0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500_000), balance(cur, dave)-d0)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusCancelled.String(), mustGet(id).Status.String())
	// Cancelled with live work counts against the poster.
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, peekProfile(alice).Cancelled)
}

func TestCancelWithoutSubmissionsIsClean(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := post(cur, alice, 1_000_000, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, peekProfile(alice).Cancelled)
}

func TestRejectAndResubmit(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := post(cur, alice, 1_000_000, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/v1", "first try")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the poster or arbiter can reject submissions", func() { Reject(cross(cur), id, bob.String(), "no") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Reject(cross(cur), id, bob.String(), "tests missing")
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "that submission was rejected", func() { Award(cross(cur), id, bob.String()) })

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/v2", "added tests")
	q := mustGet(id)
	urequire.Equal(t, 1, len(q.Subs))
	uassert.False(t, q.Subs[0].Rejected)
	uassert.Equal(t, "https://example.com/v2", q.Subs[0].Link)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, peekProfile(bob).Submitted) // update, not a new submission

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Award(cross(cur), id, bob.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusAwarded.String(), mustGet(id).Status.String())
}

func TestArbiter(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := post(cur, alice, 1_000_000, judge.String())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "the poster or arbiter cannot submit to their own quest", func() {
		Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com", "")
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/bob", "")
	b0 := balance(cur, bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Award(cross(cur), id, bob.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_000_000), balance(cur, bob)-b0)

	// arbiter cancelling does not mark the poster
	id2 := post(cur, alice, 1_000_000, judge.String())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id2, "https://example.com/carol", "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Cancel(cross(cur), id2)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, peekProfile(alice).Cancelled)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(1_000_000))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "arbiter must be someone other than the poster", func() {
		PostQuest(cross(cur), "t", "", 3, alice.String())
	})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "invalid arbiter address", func() {
		PostQuest(cross(cur), "t", "", 3, "notanaddress")
	})
}

func TestDeadlineAndExpire(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := post(cur, alice, 1_000_000, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/bob", "")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "quest can only expire 168h0m0s after its deadline", func() { Expire(cross(cur), id) })

	// 8 days later: submissions closed, still inside grace period.
	testing.SkipHeights(8 * 24 * 720)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "quest deadline has passed", func() { Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://late.example", "") })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "quest can only expire 168h0m0s after its deadline", func() { Expire(cross(cur), id) })
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("quest/1"), "until refundable"))

	// 15 days after posting: anyone can expire, poster is marked as ghosting.
	testing.SkipHeights(7 * 24 * 720)
	a0 := balance(cur, alice)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Expire(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_000_000), balance(cur, alice)-a0)
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusExpired.String(), mustGet(id).Status.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, peekProfile(alice).Ghosted)
}

func TestAwardAfterDeadlineAllowed(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	id := post(cur, alice, 1_000_000, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/bob", "")
	testing.SkipHeights(10 * 24 * 720)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Award(cross(cur), id, bob.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, StatusAwarded.String(), mustGet(id).Status.String())
}

func TestInputValidation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(99_999))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "send at least 100000ugnot", func() { PostQuest(cross(cur), "t", "", 7, "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 1_000_000}, {Denom: "foo", Amount: 1}})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "send exactly one coin type: ugnot", func() { PostQuest(cross(cur), "t", "", 7, "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "send exactly one coin type: ugnot", func() { PostQuest(cross(cur), "t", "", 7, "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(1_000_000))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "title is required", func() { PostQuest(cross(cur), "  ", "", 7, "") })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "days must be between 1 and 90", func() { PostQuest(cross(cur), "t", "", 0, "") })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "days must be between 1 and 90", func() { PostQuest(cross(cur), "t", "", 91, "") })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "title too long (max 80 bytes)", func() { PostQuest(cross(cur), strings.Repeat("x", 81), "", 7, "") })

	id := post(cur, alice, 1_000_000, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "the poster or arbiter cannot submit to their own quest", func() { Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://a.b", "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "link must start with https:// or http://", func() { Submit(cross(cur), id, "javascript:alert(1)", "") })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "quest not found", func() { Submit(cross(cur), 99, "https://a.b", "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(9_999))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "send at least 10000ugnot", func() { Fund(cross(cur), id) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "no submission from that address", func() { Award(cross(cur), id, carol.String()) })
}

func TestRender(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render(""), "No open quests yet"))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(1_250_000))
	deposit(1_250_000)
	id := PostQuest(cross(cur), "Fix | pipes *and* [links](javascript:x)", "# not a heading\n\nbody", 7, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://example.com/pr/1", "see PR")

	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "**1** open quests"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "1.25 GNOT"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, `Fix \| pipes`)) // table-safe title
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "$help&func=PostQuest"))

	page := Render("quest/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "## Submissions (1)"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "[link](https://example.com/pr/1)"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "func=Submit&id=1"))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(page, "\n# not a heading")) // body cannot inject headings

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	Award(cross(cur), id, bob.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render(""), "Recently closed"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("quest/1"), "**winner**"))

	prof := Render("u/" + alice.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(prof, "Paid out: **1** quests, **1.25 GNOT**"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("u/"+carol.String()), "No activity"))

func TestPostSubmitAward(cur realm, t *testing.T) {

	uassert.Equal(t, int64(150), totalGrossCents)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(21), poolCents)

	// Driving vehicles can't take jobs.
	who = alice
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	truck := RegisterNode(cross(cur), "Truck", KindVehicle, "AI4", "US-NY", PowerPowershare, 20)

func TestLeaderboardOrder(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	a := registerGPU(cur, alice, "Small", 10)
	b := registerGPU(cur, bob, "Big", 100)
	c := registerGPU(cur, carol, "Idle", 50)
	bringOnline(cur, alice, a)
	bringOnline(cur, bob, b)

	who = bob
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	RecordJob(cross(cur), b, "batch", 600) // 1000c gross

	leaderboard.Iterate("", "", func(_ string, v any) bool {

		return false
	})
	urequire.Equal(t, 3, len(order), "one leaderboard entry per node")
	uassert.Equal(t, b, order[0])
	uassert.Equal(t, a, order[1])
	uassert.Equal(t, c, order[2])
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, rankOf(mustGetNode(b)))
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, rankOf(mustGetNode(c)))

	who = alice

		RecordJob(cross(cur), a, "batch", 1440)
	}

	uassert.Equal(t, 1, rankOf(mustGetNode(a)))
}

func TestDistributeBonus(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	a := registerGPU(cur, alice, "Small", 10)
	b := registerGPU(cur, bob, "Big", 1000)
	c := registerGPU(cur, carol, "Offline", 50)
	bringOnline(cur, alice, a)
	bringOnline(cur, bob, b)
	who = carol
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	SetAvailability(cross(cur), c, ModeAvailable) // available but never heartbeated

	who = carol
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	urequire.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "the fairness pool is empty", func() {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
		DistributeBonus(cross(cur))
	})

	who = bob
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	RecordJob(cross(cur), b, "training", 60) // 1000c gross, 140c to the pool
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(140), poolCents)

	who = carol
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who)) // anyone can crank it
	shared := DistributeBonus(cross(cur))
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, shared, "only online + available nodes share")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(70), mustGetNode(a).BonusCents, "small node gets an equal share")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(70), mustGetNode(b).BonusCents)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), mustGetNode(c).BonusCents)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), poolCents)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(140), poolPaidCents)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, bonusRounds)

	// Rate limited to once per hour.
	who = bob
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	RecordJob(cross(cur), b, "training", 1) // 16c gross, 2c pool
	urequire.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "the bonus can be distributed at most once per hour", func() {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))

		DistributeBonus(cross(cur))
	})

	// After an hour with everyone offline, nobody is eligible.
	testing.SkipHeights(12 * 61)
	urequire.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "no node is online and available to share the pool", func() {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))

		DistributeBonus(cross(cur))
	})

	// A remainder smaller than one cent per node stays in the pool.
	bringOnline(cur, alice, a)
	bringOnline(cur, bob, b)
	who = carol
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	Heartbeat(cross(cur), c, "")
	poolCents = 2
	urequire.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "the pool is too small to split", func() {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))

		DistributeBonus(cross(cur))
	})
}

func TestAdmin(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()

		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
		SetPaused(cross(cur), true)
	})
}

package idlewatt

func TestFormatting(t *testing.T) {

	uassert.Equal(t, "-$2.00", fmtUSD(-200))
	uassert.Equal(t, "000000042", padID(42))
	uassert.True(t, rankKey(500, 1) < rankKey(100, 1), "higher totals sort first")
	uassert.True(t, rankKey(100, 1) < rankKey(100, 2), "ties go to the older node")
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, pageParam(""))
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, pageParam("page=3"))
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, pageParam("page=-1"))
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, pageParam("page=abc"))
}

func TestRenderEmpty(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	out := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(out, "# <gno-icon name=\"lightning\" /> IdleWatt"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(out, "no Tesla or Akash integration"), "disclaimer is always shown")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(out, "No nodes yet"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(out, "<gno-form exec=\"RegisterNode\">"))
}

func TestRenderPages(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	who = alice
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	truck := RegisterNode(cross(cur), "Tonawanda Cybertruck (simulated)", KindVehicle, "AI4 + AMD Ryzen", "US-NY Tonawanda", PowerPowershare, 30)
	gpu := registerGPU(cur, bob, "Garage RTX 4090", 45)
	bringOnline(cur, bob, gpu)
	who = bob
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	RecordJob(cross(cur), gpu, "llama-3.3-70b inference", 120)
	who = alice
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	SetAvailability(cross(cur), truck, ModeDriving)

	home := Render("")
	for _, want := range []string{
		"Tonawanda Cybertruck (simulated)",
		"Garage RTX 4090",
		"<gno-columns>",
		"<gno-frame>",
		"Fairness pool",
		"1 out driving",
		"$0.90", // 120 min at 45c/h
		"Driving",
		"Online, available",
		"Split the pool now",
		"llama-3.3-70b inference",
	} {
		uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, want), "home page missing: "+want)
	}
	// Leaderboard puts the earner first.
	uassert.True(t, strings.Index(home, "🥇 | [Garage RTX 4090]") > 0, "gpu should rank first")

	page := Render("node/" + itoa(truck))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "# <gno-icon name=\"battery-charging\" /> Tonawanda Cybertruck (simulated)"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "label=\"Driving\""), "vehicles get a driving button")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "$help&func=Heartbeat"), "action links open prefilled tx forms")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "No jobs yet"))

	gpage := Render("node/" + itoa(gpu))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(gpage, "label=\"Driving\""), "no driving button for a GPU box")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(gpage, "Rank: #1 of 2"))

	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("nodes"), "| 2 | [Garage RTX 4090]"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("leaderboard"), "Garage RTX 4090"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("jobs"), "Simulated"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("about"), "Nakamoto Bonus"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("operator/"+alice.String()), "Tonawanda Cybertruck"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("operator/[evil](x)"), "(invalid address)"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(Render("node/999"), "# Not found"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(Render("node/abc"), "# Not found"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(Render("nope"), "# Not found"))
}

func TestRenderPagination(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	ops := []address{alice, bob, carol}
	for i := 0; i < 25; i++ {
		registerGPU(cur, ops[i%3], "Node "+itoa(i+1), int64(10+i))
	}
	p1 := Render("nodes")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(p1, "Page 1 of 3"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(p1, "[Next]"))
	p3 := Render("nodes?page=3")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(p3, "| 25 | [Node 25]"))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(p3, "| 1 | [Node 1]"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render(""), "See all 25 nodes"))
}

func itoa(i int) string {
	s := ""
	if i == 0 {
		return "0"
	}
	for i > 0 {
		s = string(rune('0'+i%10)) + s
		i /= 10
	}
	return s
}
